rationale: Record a Pulp-owned reduction in per-frame GPU work for CanvasWidget. The per-canvas offscreen layer that isolates Canvas2D's per-canvas backing store is now opened only when the recorded stream contains a command that reads its backdrop (clearRect, putImageData, or a non-source-over composite operation), plus shader effects, native painters and native GPU textures; every other stream paints under a plain save and the same bounds clip, which is pixel-identical because source-over is associative. CoreGraphicsCanvas now tracks per save level whether it opened a transparency layer, so a layer ends at its own restore and restore_to_count closes it. The change stays inside the existing CanvasWidget replay and CoreGraphics canvas backend, adds no Vellum implementation or authority transfer, and leaves the accepted expansion boundary unchanged.
